lines: Event date: 09 Jul 2026
Orca Security Report found that 99.9% of fixable AI vulnerabilities remain unpatched
This is a significant issue as AI moves into production
The report highlights the need for better AI security practices
With 99.9% of vulnerabilities unpatched, the risk of AI-related security breaches is high

lines: Unpatched vulnerabilities can lead to significant security breaches
